name: Dragon's Breath
main_effect:
[Main] Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 1 [Four Great Dragons] trait or 1 yellow card among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[Main] ＜Delay＞ (By trashing this card after the placing turn, activate the effect below.)
• Place 1 [Trial of the Four Great Dragons] from your hand in the battle area, or you may trash 1 [Four Great Dragons] trait card in your hand. If you did either, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -7000 DP for the turn.
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -7000 DP for the turn. Then, place this card in the battle area.
